name: Maya Pavlova
biography: Currently a software engineer on Meta’s GenAI Trust & Safety, Maya Pavlova’s main work these days has been on understanding how to bridge the gap between manual red teaming processes and automated solutions. Maya originally entered this world from the safety testing lens, previously working on scaling Responsible AI’s fairness evaluation platforms, she has now pivoted to the interesting problem of how to automate AI red teaming attacks to build robust adversarial stress testing platforms.
